capabilities: Render sudoku code blocks as styled 9x9 grids
Set board title, difficulty, note, size, and background via metadata keys
Mark cells as given, correct, wrong, or highlighted with token prefixes
Insert a sudoku block template from the command palette
disambiguation: Not an interactive Sudoku game; it only renders static boards from code-block markup and does not check or play puzzles.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render a Sudoku board inside a note, so puzzle markup stays as plain text.
summary: Code-block renderer that draws Sudoku boards in notes with givens, answers, wrong attempts, highlights, and pencil candidates.
